correctness.rationale: Leaf-edge reversal proves the zero multiplier at singleton leaf frequencies; a 2x2 transfer trace counts cycle sink-signed orientations exactly after subtracting both directed cycles. A separate integer enumerator validates all masks through cycle size 14 and additional boundary cases.
